name: barbell lying preacher curl
description: A preacher curl performed while lying on the bench, isolating the biceps with no body swing.
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your shoulders at one end and your feet on the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down past the end of the bench, holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar up toward your face.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight again.
